verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਨਣੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਰਖਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)nan rukh upai van kha(n)dd rakhiaa|

en.bdb: God created the sandal tree and kept it in the forest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਗਵਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: pavan gavan kar jai alakh na lakhiaa|

en.bdb: The breeze moves around the sandal but does not understand the imperceptible (nature of the tree).
The truth about the sandal comes to the forefront when it perfumes everyone with its fragrance.
The gurmukh goes beyond all the caste and the distinctions of eating taboos.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀ ਚਖਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat bhai bhai apiau pee chakhiaa|

en.bdb: He drinks the nectar of fear and love of the Lord in the holy congregation.
The Gurmukh comes face to face with his own intrinsic nature (sahaj subhai).
